blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez left the Philippine General Hospital (PGH) on Monday and will be transferred to the Quezon City Jail Male Dormitory as ordered by the Sandiganbayan. During the hearing on Romualdez’s health condition on Monday, Sandiganbayan Third Division Associate Justice Karl Miranda announced the court order after PGH Director Dr. Gerardo Legazpi said that Romualdez can be discharged from the hospital at any time for being medically stable.
